set script {cat > /tmp/i.sh <<'"'"'EOS'"'"'
#!/bin/sh
set -x
apk update
apk add openssh openssh-server openssh-client
yes | setup-disk -m sys -s 0 /dev/vda
echo "SETUP_RC=$?"
sync
ROOT=""
if [ -f /mnt/etc/alpine-release ]; then ROOT=mounted; fi
if [ -z "$ROOT" ]; then
  for p in /dev/vda1 /dev/vda2 /dev/vda3 /dev/vda4; do
    [ -b "$p" ] || continue
    mkdir -p /mnt
    if mount "$p" /mnt 2>/dev/null; then
      if [ -f /mnt/etc/alpine-release ]; then ROOT=$p; break; fi
      umount /mnt
    fi
  done
fi
echo "ROOT_DETECT=$ROOT"
mkdir -p /mnt/etc/network /mnt/etc/ssh
cat > /mnt/etc/network/interfaces <<'"'"'I'"'"'
auto lo
iface lo inet loopback

auto eth0
iface eth0 inet dhcp
I
CFG=/mnt/etc/ssh/sshd_config
sed -i -E "s/^[#[:space:]]*PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin yes/" "$CFG"
sed -i -E "s/^[#[:space:]]*PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication yes/" "$CFG"
grep -q "^PermitRootLogin" "$CFG" || echo "PermitRootLogin yes" >> "$CFG"
grep -q "^PasswordAuthentication" "$CFG" || echo "PasswordAuthentication yes" >> "$CFG"
chroot /mnt /bin/sh -c "echo root:password123 | chpasswd; rc-update add sshd default; ssh-keygen -A"
echo "CONFIG_RC=$?"
grep "^root:" /mnt/etc/shadow
ls -l /mnt/etc/ssh/
BOOT=$(awk '"'"'$2=="/boot"{print $1}'"'"' /mnt/etc/fstab)
echo "BOOTDEV=$BOOT"
if [ -n "$BOOT" ]; then
  mkdir -p /mnt/boot
  mount "$BOOT" /mnt/boot 2>/dev/null
fi
find /mnt/boot -name extlinux.conf -o -name syslinux.cfg 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
  echo "BEFORE $f"; cat "$f"
  grep -q console=ttyS0 "$f" || sed -i "s/^\([[:space:]]*APPEND .*\)$/\1 console=ttyS0,115200/" "$f"
  echo "AFTER $f"; cat "$f"
done
sync
echo "CONFIG_DONE"
cat /mnt/etc/fstab
cat /proc/partitions
EOS
sh /tmp/i.sh
echo "DONE_$((1234+5678))"
}

' 2>&1 | sed -n '/SETUP_RC=/,$p' | cat -v | tail -200
